cariad.label: CARIAD · modern
cariad.notes: Region host resolved by existing Audi adapter; not configurable as arbitrary URL.

graphql.label: GraphQL
graphql.notes: Reviewed read-only identity transport; existing inventory lifecycle owns requests.

eu_data_act.label: EU Data Act
eu_data_act.notes: Read-only dataset provider; no control or generic request executor.

mbb.label: MBB · legacy
mbb.notes: Independent V3 legacy executor, reviewed home region, climate and RLU controls.

discovery.label: Start cabin climate
discovery.instructions: With climate off, check it starts using the stored vehicle settings.

discovery.label: Stop cabin climate
discovery.instructions: With climate running, check it stops.

discovery.label: Start window heating
discovery.instructions: With window heating off, check that it starts.

discovery.label: Stop window heating
discovery.instructions: With window heating running, check that it stops.

discovery.label: Change climate target temperature
discovery.instructions: With climate off, choose a different target; check the setting changes without starting climate.

discovery.label: Start climate with temperature
discovery.instructions: Stop climate first. Choose a temperature different from the stored target; check that climate starts and applies it.

discovery.label: Lock vehicle
discovery.instructions: With the car safely accessible and unlocked, check it locks. Keep the key with you.

discovery.label: Unlock vehicle
discovery.instructions: With the vehicle locked, check that it unlocks.

discovery.label: Start charging
discovery.instructions: With the vehicle plugged in and charging stopped, check that charging starts.

discovery.label: Stop charging
discovery.instructions: While charging, check that charging actually stops; HTTP acceptance is not enough.

discovery.label: Verify preferred charging mode
discovery.instructions: Choose Manual or Timer. Check the actual preferred mode in myAudi or the vehicle before confirming. Test each desired mode separately.

discovery.label: Wake vehicle
discovery.instructions: Check whether the vehicle wakes; a successful cloud response alone is not proof.
